process_incoming_client_message: process an incoming JSON or BSON message from a rosbridge client and route to the correct operation handler
send_message_with_fragmentation: send a message to a client with automatic fragmentation if the message exceeds the configured fragment size
register_operation_handler: register a callback handler for a specific rosbridge opcode so incoming messages with that op are dispatched correctly
serialize_deserialize_messages: serialize a message dictionary to JSON or BSON and deserialize wire-level messages back into dictionaries
add_protocol_capability: add a capability class to the protocol instance to extend its functionality with new rosbridge operations
